Module advanceWars
Package co.edu.unbosque.view

Class PanelJugadores2

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
javax.swing.JPanel
co.edu.unbosque.view.PanelJugadores2
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible
public class PanelJugadores2 extends JPanel
Class representing a panel to manage the interface of a two-player game. This panel includes buttons to add and remove units (planes, soldiers, and tanks) for each player and displays relevant information such as money and unit counts.
Author:
Bustamante Castellanos Caren Sofia, Hospital Herrera Dylan Mathyus, Ramirez Chacon Alejandra Valenttina, Ruiz Cruz Gabriel Alejandro, Triana Mejia Juan Diego, Vela Cardozo German Octavio
